title: stacksplit
summary: MSUI has a working stack-split flow (shift-click a bag stack opens it; pick a count; Split places the count on the cursor; Cancel/Escape closes; GameMenuUiLaw models its escape layer). But it is a plain ImGui window with a SliderInt, anchored at the mouse, not the vanilla 172x96 UI-MoneyFrame parchment spinner.

openItems.text: Vanilla StackSplitFrame visuals absent: UI-MoneyFrame parchment plate, Arrow-Left/Right spinner buttons with disabled states, OKAY/CANCEL UI-Panel-Button faces (MSUI draws an ImGui slider window instead)
Frame is anchored at the mouse cursor, not to the owning slot (ref anchors BOTTOMRIGHT of the owner button)
Split maximum is stackCount-1 (ref allows splitting up to the full stack count)
